answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in cedar, verified in ivory, and ripple names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 22 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 344 aliases cost 213 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
